body:
![-](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fc7d84966f1f444d681b42fc92a5d529f9aed5fd.png) ![partyhat.lol](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/583cf82f97521fdb2aabdda7824df39077f84a4e.png)


partyhat.lol is a Minecraft anarchy server running on version 1.12.2, online since March 2026.

![-](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fc7d84966f1f444d681b42fc92a5d529f9aed5fd.png)

There are no rules. Griefing, raiding, swearing and hacking are all allowed.

![-](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fc7d84966f1f444d681b42fc92a5d529f9aed5fd.png)

The server focuses on vanilla survival gameplay. There are no teleport commands like /tpa, /home or /sethome. Travel and survival work the same way as in normal Minecraft.

![-](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fc7d84966f1f444d681b42fc92a5d529f9aed5fd.png)

The map is still new and mostly unexplored, so players joining now have the chance to be part of the early history of the server.

![-](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fc7d84966f1f444d681b42fc92a5d529f9aed5fd.png)

Everything you see on the server is created by the players.
